justifications.r1: Grixis mana rocks and treasure generation deploying 6-mana Sauron on Turn 5.
justifications.r2: Repeatable wheel/refuel draw whenever the Ring tempts you.
justifications.a1: High density of Ring tempting triggers and amass cards.
justifications.a2: Deploys Sauron and establishes amass/wheel engine on Turns 5–6.
justifications.p1: Presents massive 10+/10+ Orc Army and Ring bearer clock on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: Requires 2 opponent untap steps for combat damage.
justifications.p3: High ward cost makes Sauron difficult to answer cleanly.
justifications.i1: Grixis countermagic and destroy removal (Feed the Swarm, Bedevil, Blasphemous Act).
justifications.i2: Incidental ring tempt triggers; no hard resource locks.
justifications.s1: Sauron possesses inherent Ward: Sacrifice a legendary creature or artifact.
justifications.s2: Graveyard reanimation packages rebuild army post-wipe.
justifications.s3: Sauron is the primary engine center.
